name: Boreal Waters Biodiversity Fund
summary: Small one-year and larger multi-year grants for nonprofits and community groups restoring habitat and protecting vulnerable species and ecosystems in the Duluth-Superior region, through a letter of intent then invited application.

amount.note: Large multi-year grants go up to $50,000 a year for up to three years

fiscal_sponsor.note: The sponsor is a 501(c)(3), public entity, Tribal government or church

eligibility.rule: Is a 501(c)(3), public entity, Tribal government or church, or has a fiscal sponsor that is one
Serves communities within the foundation's service area
Not for construction, fundraising, lobbying, religion, medical research, debt, regranting or endowments

geography.quote: The Biodiversity Fund supports projects that preserve and restore habitats, assist vulnerable species and ecosystems, plan for environmental change, and promote research and education in the Duluth-Superior region.

window.quote: 2026 Biodiversity Grant - Timeline February 9 | Letter of Intent (LOI) open March 9 at 5 PM

amount.quote: Small Grants: Awards may support one-year projects ranging from $5,000 to $50,000 for focused activities such as pilot projects, planning efforts, community engagement, research, or early-stage restoration work. Large & Multi-Year Grants (NEW THIS YEAR): The Fund may also support larger initiatives of up to $50,000 per year for up to three years

The organization must serve communities within the Boreal Waters Community Foundation's service area.
